aiMetadata.description: Send a user message to a specific Chatling chatbot and get back the AI-generated reply, querying the bot's knowledge base. Use to converse with or test a deployed chatbot programmatically. Requires the chatbot ID and message; optionally pass a conversation_id to continue an existing thread (omit it to start a new one) and tune the AI model, language, temperature, or extra instructions. Not idempotent — each call generates a fresh response and appends to the conversation.
